displayDescription: Four coated performers slide into taped marks one pose at a time, then a hand-held cable links them to a glowing idea bulb.
styleRenderer: Canvas 2D (procedural performers, stationary pre-rendered studio set with seeded grain)
HTML/CSS DOM text (Courier New system font)
motionEngine: GSAP paused timeline at window.__timelines.video (single owner of composition time)
Authored exposure sheet: 15 poses/s, each held 2 frames at 30 fps, poses looked up by exposure index
audioDescription: Silent preview: no audio track, music, voice or sound effects.
limitations: Nobody was photographed. This is a procedural Canvas 2D stand-in for photographed pixilation frames: performers, coats, cable and lamps are drawn shapes with simulated key light, rim light, cast shadows and grain.

Pixilation craft is simulated through an authored exposure sheet (32 planned poses on twos, discrete position jumps, a slide with feet together, arrival recoil, held-pose wobble). It is not reduced-frame-rate footage and not real stop-frame photography.
Bulb and lamp glows are additive radial gradients, not measured lighting. Wall spill is approximate.
Blender was not used, at the user's request. No WebGL/Three.js was needed because the scene is a frontal flat-staged set.

BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json reports 0 matched sources and no contact sheets, so no source-frame observations were applied. The cool slate studio is a scene-dependent choice, not taken from any source evidence.
STYLE.json lists no tech.preview_recipes, so no reviewed recipe is demonstrated. The preview shows the core style only.
